notes.title: Vorax is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
Attention, Mercenaries, 

the moment you've been waiting for is here.

Vorax is AVAILABLE NOW in Early access and is 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

[previewyoutube=B8nhhzQQPH0;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access release marks an important milestone in a journey that has spanned over two years and half, filled with dedication and hard work.
Creating Vorax has been a labor of love and commitment. We have faced numerous challenges and obstacles. We've had intense development cycles and had to overcome various technical issues or limitations. Not to mention a big reshuffle in the team that took place last year due to that we decided to rewrote all core game code from scratch.  
Throughout it all, our motivation has been to deliver a game that meets the high standards we set for ourselves and that our community expects. However this is only the first step.

Delay :
We want to apologize and address the delay in our initial launch plans. This decision was not made lightly. Our guiding principle has always been to prioritize quality over profits. We believe in taking the time to do things right, even if it means making difficult decisions along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/c0afa52250c53e1d3c24d12571983ca72de574db.png

We received valuable feedback from Valve and several trustworthy community members and content creators. Their insights highlighted areas where Vorax could benefit from additional polish. While we felt the game was ready for Early Access release, we recognized the importance of making a strong first impression. An Early Access launch on Steam is a significant event, and we want to ensure that Vorax is as polished as possible for this crucial moment.

We took the occasion to introduce at last second two much requested features like:


 headbob removal ( now it is disabled by default )
 multiple shotgun shells 


and we are working to re-introduce our 'vintage' orange HUD in a couple of days this week.

 Our goal is to exceed your expectations and deliver a game that truly stands out in the survival horror genre.

Current Status and Future Plans:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/f3d88c4648b65914929c04863097b4a1a5190004.jpg

The Early Access launch of Vorax is just the beginning. The game has already a lot of content , but with your help with will grow even more. We are committed to continuously improving and enhancing the game based on your feedback. Our roadmap includes regular updates, new content, and ongoing refinements to ensure that Vorax evolves and improves over time.

Over the next few months, we have several key updates planned to expand and enrich your experience with Vorax, just to remind you a few key locations: The School, Electric Central, Sanctuary, Olive Factory and more. New Weapons, New Features and Improvements, expect various enhancements and optimizations to improve gameplay and performance.


Closing reminder:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/51947278bece47ba2d3d1194a51277d66a93d75a.jpg

Engage with the new content as it becomes available, thoroughly test all features, and report any issues encountered.

Your feedback is crucial to refining these updates and ensuring the best possible experience.

We encourage you to order Vorax from our website located here if you'd like to support us. 

If you haven't already, please make sure to wishlist and follow Vorax on Steam here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

If you have any feedback or any questions, you may get in touch with us by joining our Discord. Your constant support is what helps us make this game great:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/5bb2433aad01fce79766323ac1cd5fb9c55d7a59.png

Thank you for your unwavering support and commitment.

notes.title: PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178. Codename: Vorax
notes.content:
PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178.

Information in our possession is conflicting, but it seems that the infection has spread very quickly within a few days, perhaps even in a few hours.
It seems that in the hours immediately following the outbreak of the infection, 43rd NATO airborne battalion was sent to the island but all contacts were lost after only 8 hours.

PMCW considers this matter with the utmost importance.
Objectives of team W1 are:

 Locate the biolab
 Take in vitro samples of the pathogen (codename: "Vorax")
 Liquidate surviving medical personnel (optionally) and any witnesses.

In NO case must the presence of the PMCW be revealed.
 
Every W1 squad member is equipped with cyanide capsules. 
Squad commander is authorized to start liquidation procedure in case of emergency.

Proceed with the utmost caution.

[previewyoutube=-xl04-CDLv0;full][/previewyoutube]

THE ENVIRONMENT

The island is vast and offers a wide variety of natural resources. There are also several settlements, a main village, a hotel and tourist attractions.
In the event of an emergency landing, or loss of tactical equipment, each squad member is trained to survive in a hostile environment.
As a good mercenary of a private military company, you know how to use local plants and herbs to make ointments and medications to treat state effects such as burns, bleeding, relieve your stress or simply restore your health.
But more importantly, you can use building materials provided by nature to make rudimentary melee weapons, traps, barricades and much more.  Even a silent bow, very useful for knocking out the infected without being detected.

THE INFECTION

It seems that the infected are the side effect of the virus grown in the bio-laboratory.
Probably when a security flaw opened, the virus spread to the island.

It is not yet clear whether it spreads by air or through aquifers but what is certain is that biomass, similar to fleshy appendages that are sometimes glimpsed in the environment, are one of the final stages of the virus.
The biomass therefore seems to be responsible for the mutations that occurred to the civilian inhabitants and to the military personnel who rushed to contain the first stages of the infection.
Contact with non-bottled liquids or non-canned food is therefore  strictly prohibited.

Mutates are fast, extremely aggressive and above all voracious.
The first to be devoured were the breeding animals of the surrounding farms and estates.
For this reason, any living being, human or animal, is for them a prey.

Apparently they do not devour each other ( to be confirmed ).

Finally, it seems that they are photosensitive. 
At least the infected humans.
Our drones have in fact observed the absence of external diurnal activity by the mutants, even if some animal species that have come into contact with the pathogen, such as stray dogs, wolves, wild boars and bears, do not seem to suffer from photosensitivity.

It is therefore recommended to exercise extreme caution at night.


OPERATIONAL INFO

You will land in the North area, a few hundred meters from the bio-laboratory, at 4.30 in the morning.
The helicopter will wait 25 minutes and then will take off.

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.content:
Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4
https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with two pleasant surprises.

Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Don’t miss the “Blockstorm Reward” initiative!
notes.content:
PROVE THAT YOU ARE ONE OF THE BEST PLAYER IN BLOCKSTORM AND WIN!

Every week we’ll reward the top 10 players with an Indiegala Every Monday Bundle!


What’s the “Blockstorm Reward” initiative?

The “Blockstorm Reward” initiative will award every week the top 10 players of Blockstorm.
Every Monday we’ll check the weekly leaderboards in every game mode and the 10 best players who played between 00:00 UTC until Sunday 23:59 UTC of the past week will get the prize.

What kind of reward will I receive? 

Every winner will get an Every Monday Bundle, ONLY the current Every Monday Bundle at that time. If you are one of the winner, you will be immediately able to redeem your prize so if you will press “Get your Prize” button in your account you will get the current Monday bundle at the time.

How can I get this reward?

It’s simple!
- Play at your best and get in the top 10 weekly ranking
- An Indiegala profile (if you don’t have one go to www.indiegala.com and sign up)
- Connect your Indiegala account to your Steam profile (first time only needed)
- Press the button “Get your Prize” in your account and enjoy your bundle!

When can I get my prize?

You will be able to redeem your bundle from Monday 00:00 UTC till Sunday 23:59 UTC.
Please keep in mind that when you redeem your bundle, you will get the ONLY the current Every Monday Bundle at that time. If you will not redeem your prize, you will lose the chance to get it when the leaderboards will be reset.

notes.title: Update 0.95 is out!
notes.content:
The following changes are all based on the suggestions made by the AWESOME community of Blockstorm in official forums and Steam forums!


 [Maps] Deathmatch map "Medieval Hell" added
http://s13.postimg.org/yi6d1ejwn/medhellprev.png
 [Maps] Assault map "Outpost Attack" added
http://s10.postimg.org/76x8z25dl/outpostpreview.png
 [Maps] "Bridge Pass" has an indestructible layer under the helipad
 [Maps] "Bridge Pass" is also available in the official Team Deathmatch servers

 [Gameplay] Kill assists now have a proper score (not yet counted in statistics, but we'll add them soon)
 [Gameplay] Death by falling over is no more considered as suicide if there's a cause like an explosion, a falling structure or a burst of bullets. On the countrary, the kill score is assigned to the causing player(s).
 [Gameplay] Explosions propagates to near explosives

 [GUI] Chat and events are split in two logs for better readability
 [GUI] "Tab" key let you see also older chat messages and events

 [Weapons] The reload time of the Shotgun/Shorty depends on the number of shells to be charged.
 [Weapons] Sniper inertia effect is slightly lowered
 [Weapons] The Rocket launcher now has a delay between shoot and the actual rocket launch to avoid overuse in short distances.
 [Weapons] Shotgun hitten graphics (the red arc) was reversed, now it's fixed
 [Weapons] AK47, Handgun, M240 precision was slightly modified

 [Audio] Fixed some bugs on weapon recharge
 [Performance] Faster load time for characters
 [Performance] Better lag management

 [Fix] Fixed a problem when falling into lava
 [Fix] Fixed a speed issue when jumping and aiming
 [Fix] Fixed some problems when placing explosives
 [Fix] Minor bug fixes
